channel.title: External
channel.description: Notes on undergraduate mathematics by Yeonsol Kim, written out in full: definitions, theorems, and proofs in set theory, logic, algebra, analysis, and probability.
channel.itunes:author: Yeonsol Kim

item.title: 1.5 The Span Operator
item.description: The span as a closure operator: closure operators and Moore collections, subspaces as the closed sets, and the finitary and exchange properties of span. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/linear-algebra/the-span-operator/

item.title: 1.1 The Trading Industry
item.description: Traders are people who arrange trades for themselves, have others arrange trades on their behalf, or arrange trades for others. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/trading-and-exchanges/the-trading-industry/

item.title: 3.4 Limit Superior and Limit Inferior
item.description: Divergence to ±∞, the limit superior and limit inferior of a real sequence from its tails and its subsequential limits, and how they decide convergence. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/introduction-to-analysis/limit-superior-and-limit-inferior/

item.title: 3.3 Cauchy Sequences
item.description: Cauchy sequences and diameters, why convergent sequences are Cauchy, Cauchy sequences in compact spaces, the completeness of ℝᵏ, and complete metric spaces. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/introduction-to-analysis/cauchy-sequences/

item.title: 3.2 Subsequences
item.description: Subsequences and subsequential limits, convergent subsequences in compact metric spaces, the Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem, and the set of subsequential limits. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/introduction-to-analysis/subsequences/

item.title: 2.4 Connected Sets
item.description: Separated sets and connected sets in a metric space, a characterization by relatively open sets, and the connected subsets of the real line. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/introduction-to-analysis/connected-sets/

item.title: 3.1 Convergent Sequences
item.description: Convergent sequences in metric spaces: limits and boundedness, monotone sequences, limit laws, coordinatewise convergence in ℝᵏ, and some standard limits. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/introduction-to-analysis/convergent-sequences/

item.title: 2.3 Perfect Sets
item.description: Isolated points and perfect sets, why every nonempty perfect subset of ℝᵏ is uncountable, and the Cantor set as a perfect, uncountable set. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/introduction-to-analysis/perfect-sets/

item.title: 2.2 Compact Sets
item.description: Compactness in metric spaces: open covers, closed subsets, the finite-intersection property, nested k-cells, and the Heine–Borel and Bolzano–Weierstrass theorems. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/introduction-to-analysis/compact-sets/

item.title: 1.1 Outcomes, Events, and Counting
item.description: Sample spaces and events, the addition and multiplication rules, permutations and combinations, Pascal’s identity, and the binomial theorem. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/probability-theory/outcomes-events-and-counting/

item.title: 1.3 Subspaces
item.description: Subspaces and the subspace test, examples from matrices, polynomials, and continuous functions, sums and direct sums, cosets, and quotient spaces. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/linear-algebra/subspaces/

item.title: 1.2 Vector Spaces
item.description: Vector spaces over a field, with the standard examples of n-tuples, matrices, functions, and polynomials, and the first consequences of the axioms. Read the page at https://yeonsolkim.com/linear-algebra/vector-spaces/
